checks.name: Shell installation does not force updates to activate
Storage quota error is explicitly reported
Partial downloads are not reported as ready
Retry after quota failure completes every required resource
Query/hash navigation resolves cached document without network
Redirected navigation response is rebuilt as non-redirected HTML
Normalized HTML keeps MIME type, discards obsolete encoded length
Original source media is never intercepted
Activation only clears outdated caches in its own scope
Explicit update message can activate the waiting worker
